purpose.summary: This program (ORCGW11) is part of the ORCA JMA (Japan Medical Association) standard medical receipt software system. It handles system management information settings, specifically printer assignment and window/screen management for output destinations. It processes screen navigation, initialization, data entry, and display for a subsystem configuration screen.

notable_features: Extensive use of COPY statements for copybooks (W01.INC through W99.INC, WERR.INC, WID1.INC, WID2.INC, CPSYSKANRI.INC, CPSK1030.INC, CPSK1031.INC, etc.)
PROCEDURE DIVISION USING with MCPAREA, SPAAREA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA — MCP (Message Control Program) style online framework
EVALUATE MCP-STATUS ALSO MCP-EVENT — event-driven screen handling
Japanese comments encoded in latin-1 (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS garbled as latin-1)
Revision history spanning 2000–2006 with multiple contributors
No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS
15 CALL statements, 258 PERFORM statements, 24 GOTO statements
Open-source JMA ORCA medical software project
verdict.notes: The file is decoded as latin-1 but the comments contain Japanese text (likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS), which appears garbled. The program is clearly production-grade medical software from the JMA ORCA open-source project, with a detailed revision history. The MCP-based framework (MCP-STATUS, MCP-EVENT, MCP-WINDOW, PUT-WINDOW) is characteristic of the ORCA system's own screen management layer rather than CICS, but the program_type is classified as online because it is an interactive screen-handling program driven by events.
